newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish lower house to vote on budget in two weeks.
newsitem.headline: Polish lower house to vote on budget in two weeks.

text.p: The lower house of Polish parliament will vote on the 1997 budget draft in two weeks, Finance Minister Grzegorz Kolodko said on Monday.
"The budget draft will be voted on in the Sejm in two weeks," PAP quoted Kolodko as saying.
The budget draft envisages a deficit of 12.2 billion zlotys or 2.8 percent of gross domestic product, the same percentage gap that had been set for 1996.
A deficit of 2.6 percent had been planned for 1997 until last November, when parliament cut taxes.
This year's budget sees year-on-year inflation, which was at 19.1 percent in November, falling to 13 percent in December 1997.
